maria.su: FYI — ACME (Zendesk #12345) just reported that after the v3.2.1 model bump their help-article generator started producing noticeably shorter and slightly more formal responses. They say the 'brand voice' got muted. Attaching two customer examples below. @chris.k @sam.j can you triage?

chris.k: I ran a quick repro against the hosted endpoint: model=redwood-base-v3.2.0 vs redwood-base-v3.2.1 using the customer's prompt. Repro steps:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-base-v3.2.1","input":"Write a short help article for cancelling a subscription, friendly brand tone","temperature":0.2, "max_tokens":120}'
```
Outputs (trimmed):
- v3.2.0: "Sure — here's how to cancel your subscription in 3 quick steps. If you need more help, reply and we'll assist. Step 1..."
- v3.2.1: "To cancel, go to Settings > Billing and click Cancel. Contact support for questions."

maria.su: Customer confirms they make no prompt overrides and call our hosted API directly. They noticed change ~48h after the upgrade. They called it out as a regression because tone/verbosity impacts their UX and conversions. They've asked for a rollback or workaround ASAP.

sam.j: Deployment notes — v3.2.1 was promoted to prod ~2024-06-12 03:20 UTC after a 10% canary 24h earlier. Change log: small tokenizer patch, and a fine-tune step that included a brevity-promoting objective on some system prompts to reduce average tokens. Canary metrics looked fine (latency/cost), but we didn't have a style classifier in the pipeline for this release.

chris.k: I dug into the candidate diffs. There's a subtle decoding-prior tweak: presence_penalty moved from -0.2 -> +0.05 in the rollout config for the hosted default. That would discourage repetition and could lead to shorter answers. Also the fine-tune dataset included some terse examples. Quick A/B shows avg token length drop ~18% on the customer's prompt set.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: redwood-base-v3.2.1 promoted to prod by sam.j at commit f2c4a1b (2024-06-12T03:20:11Z). Canary: 10% -> 100% in 24h.

maria.su: Customer wants a rollback for their workspace or an immediate mitigation. They are ok with a per-tenant pin if that helps while you investigate. Can we do pinning?

chris.k: Yes — we can route their org to v3.2.0 via tenant-level routing in the console. That will be the fastest customer-visible fix (<30m). Global rollback is heavier (we need product + infra signoff since we touched tokenizer). Alternative mitigations: inject a small guideline system prompt at the proxy layer to enforce brand tone/verbosity, or add a post-process that expands outputs if too short.

sam.j: Action items: 1) Support to get 3 canonical customer prompts + expected tone examples (maria). 2) ML to run an ensemble A/B across 200 seed prompts and post metrics (chris). Metrics: avg token length, style-classifier score, BLEU/ROUGE vs desired tone. 3) Infra to prepare tenant pin and rollback playbook (me). 4) Create internal bug (ml-regen-1729) and link logs.

maria.su: I'll ask ACME for the 3 canonical prompts and sample "preferred" outputs by EOD and file the Zendesk update. I'll also offer tenant pin to v3.2.0 while you evaluate.

chris.k: I'll run batch eval now and paste results here in ~2h. Early quick-run: avg tokens down 19%, style-clf score down 0.17 (on our internal informal vs friendly classifier). Suspect the brevity objective + presence_penalty shift.

sam.j: If A/B confirms systemic regression we should consider rolling back to v3.2.0 globally overnight. For now prepare per-tenant pin and a prompt wrapper that forces an explicit "tone: friendly, verbose" instruction.

maria.su: Customer asked for ETA. I'll tell them we can pin them to v3.2.0 within 30m and that ML is investigating root cause; will update with findings. :thumbsup:

chris.k: tagging results when ready. Also logging the exact API headers and default param changes to the release note so support can triage similar cases faster.

sam.j: Thanks — keep me posted. I'll open the infra change request to enable fast rollback for any impacted tenants.

maria.su: Thanks team — I'll close the loop with the customer after pin.
